title: Retraction: The App Store Rejection of the Week That Was a Correct Rejection
summary: Daring Fireball's John Gruber retracts his previous criticism of an App Store rejection after realizing the rejection was actually justified. This is a case of a prominent tech blogger publicly acknowledging an error in his original assessment.
problem_solved: Corrects misinformation about App Store policies that was spread to a wide audience through a popular tech blog.
why_valuable: Demonstrates intellectual honesty and responsible tech journalism by publicly admitting error rather than doubling down.
